payload.name: Photo 120x160 Under 20KB by PrintableTools Lab
payload.short_description: Free no-signup 120 x 160 photo workflow for strict 20KB upload limits.
payload.long_description: A free browser-based 120 x 160 photo under 20KB workflow for exam, school, profile, and application forms that require exact portrait pixels plus a tiny file-size cap. It points to local resize and image-to-KB compression steps, requires no account and no server file upload, and includes an optional USD 9 Upload Limit Fix Plan request after a public-safe fit check.
